sources.text: Gas hydrate occurs in marine sediment at site CUG-3. Pore-water salinity is 3.5 wt% NaCl equivalent. The hydrate stability zone extends 12 m below the seafloor.
Dissociation pressure increases by 0.9 MPa when salinity rises from 0 to 3.5 wt% at 4 °C. Permeability of the sandy layer is one order of magnitude higher than that of the clay.
